description: Source code implementing SGD optimizer for mobile JIT in PyTorch, including class methods, operator overloads, and optimizer step logic.

classes.name: SGDParamGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of parameters for SGD optimizer, with options and parameter list.

classes.name: SGDOptions
classes.description: Holds options for SGD optimizer such as learning rate, momentum, dampening, weight decay, and Nesterov flag.

classes.name: SGDParamState
classes.description: Stores state information for individual parameters, such as momentum buffer.

classes.name: SGD
classes.description: Implements the stochastic gradient descent optimizer with methods to add parameter groups, zero gradients, and perform optimization steps.

methods.name: has_options
methods.description: Checks if the parameter group has options set.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns a reference to the options of the parameter group.

methods.name: set_options
methods.description: Sets the options for the parameter group.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters in the group.

methods.name: SGDOptions
methods.description: Constructor initializing SGD options with a specified learning rate.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for SGDOptions and SGDParamState.

methods.name: add_param_group
methods.description: Adds a parameter group to the optimizer, with checks for leaf tensors and parameter uniqueness.

methods.name: zero_grad
methods.description: Zeros out gradients for all parameters in all groups.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs an optimization step, updating parameters based on gradients and options.
